title: KARBALA KA DASHT
body:
Qayamat ki tapish hai Karbala ka dasht jalta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Madine ka Musafir khaak par karwat badalta hai
Kaha'n hain Hazrate Ayub dekhe'n sabr ke Johar
Jawa'n Beta hai Godi me Pidar ki dam nikalta hai
<<MINI>>
Qayamat ki tapish hai Karbala ka dasht jalta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye poochha karte the Tifli me Akbar Sheh se kyun Baba
Jawani me jo mowt aaye to dam kyunkar nikalta hai
<<MINI>>
Qayamat ki tapish hai Karbala ka dasht jalta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaha Sheh ne ye Bano se ke Khaime me Chali jao
Ali Asghar ka Manka dhal chuka ab dam nikalta hai
<<MINI>>
Qayamat ki tapish hai Karbala ka dasht jalta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Laeeno Sayyade Sajjad par kode na barsaao
Bohut bimar hai iswaaste ruk ruk ke chata hai
<<MINI>>
Qayamat ki tapish hai Karbala ka dasht jalta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Zara Uthkar Lahad se Dekh lije Ya Rasul Allah
Janaze par Janaza Apke Ghar se nikalta hai
<<MINI>>
Qayamat ki tapish hai Karbala ka dasht jalta hai
author: Qais Zangipuri
